accountTypes.decimals.info: Points earned by Spending rules are rounded down to this many decimal places (0–4).
accountTypes.warningDays.label: Expiry warning (days before)
accountTypes.warningDays.hint: Customers get an "expiring soon" notice this many days before their points expire.
accountTypes.warningDays.needsExpiry: Set Points expiration first — a warning needs an expiry date.
accountTypes.warningDays.positive: Enter a whole number of days greater than 0.
accountTypes.warningDays.beforeExpiry: Must be less than Points expiration (days).
accountTypes.tierQualifying.label: Tier qualifying account
accountTypes.tierQualifying.hint: Points in this wallet count toward tiers. Only one per program; locked while the program is active.
accountTypes.currency.label: Currency
accountTypes.currency.locked: Currency cannot be changed after creation.
accountTypes.cash.noExpiry: Cash balances are real credit and never expire.
programs.tierQualifying.movedHint: Set on the account type (Account Types → Tier qualifying account).
rules.priority.hint: Higher numbers win when exclusive rules on the same target account would otherwise both fire.
rules.stackable.label: Stackable with other rules
rules.stackable.hint: Stackable rules always add their award on top. Exclusive rules compete per target account — the highest-priority match wins.
programs.status.label: Status
programs.status.hint: Inactive programs stop earning and burning immediately. Toggling does not need a publish.
programs.status.draftHint: Publish the program before activating it.
programs.publication.upToDate: Nothing has changed since the last publish.
programs.publication.confirmMessage: This records a new version of "{{name}}" with all its account types, tiers, rewards and rules.
history.published.heading: Published versions
history.changes.heading: Change log
rules.groups.intro: Rules are grouped the way the engine applies them. For each event, every trigger → account card is resolved separately: one exclusive rule can win per account, and all matching stackable rules add on top. Greyed-out rules are not active and do not compete.
rules.groups.exclusiveHint: One winner per event on this account: the engine tries active rules from the highest priority down and awards only the first that matches. Lower ones only fire when the ones above them don't match.
rules.groups.stackableHint: Every matching rule fires and adds its award on top of the winner. Priority only sets the posting order — it doesn't change the amounts.
rules.groups.outsideHint: Transfer and Reversal rules post through their own processing — they neither compete with nor stack on other rules.
rules.groups.rank.tie: Tied top priority — engine picks by rule id
rules.limits.heading: Limits (optional)
rules.limits.intro: Caps that stop this rule from paying out indefinitely. Leave a field blank for no limit.
rules.limits.groups.customer.title: Per customer
rules.limits.groups.customer.hint: How much one customer can earn from this rule.
rules.limits.groups.event.title: Per event
rules.limits.groups.event.hint: Checked on every event before the rule pays out.
rules.limits.groups.rule.title: Whole rule
rules.limits.groups.period.title: Period window
rules.limits.groups.period.hint: Used by the "per period" caps above.
rules.limits.groups.breach.title: When a cap is reached
rules.limits.groups.breach.hint: Applies to the rule budgets and the per-customer per-period cap. Cooldown, minimum amount and max customers always skip.
rules.limits.perCustomerTotal.label: Total
rules.limits.perCustomerTotal.hint: Lifetime points one customer can earn.
rules.limits.perCustomerPerDay.label: Per day
rules.limits.perCustomerPerPeriod.label: Per period
rules.limits.maxPerEvent.label: Max award per event
rules.limits.maxPerEvent.hint: Larger awards are cut to this.
rules.limits.minEventAmount.label: Minimum event amount
rules.limits.cooldownHours.label: Cooldown
rules.limits.cooldownHours.hint: Wait between awards to the same customer, e.g. 1.5.
rules.limits.ruleBudgetTotal.label: Budget, total
rules.limits.ruleBudgetTotal.hint: Points this rule can ever pay out.
rules.limits.ruleBudgetPerPeriod.label: Budget, per period
rules.limits.maxCustomers.label: Max distinct customers
rules.limits.maxCustomers.hint: After this many customers, nobody new earns.
rules.limits.period.label: Period
rules.limits.resetWindow.label: Resets
rules.limits.resetWindow.Calendar: At the start of each calendar period (UTC)
rules.limits.resetWindow.Rolling: Rolling — counts the last full period up to now
rules.limits.onBreach.Clamp: Clamp — pay only what is left of the cap
rules.limits.errors.format.points: Enter a number, up to 4 decimal places (e.g. 250 or 12.5).
rules.limits.errors.format.amount: Enter an amount, up to 4 decimal places (e.g. 100 or 49.99).
rules.limits.errors.format.hours: Enter hours, up to 2 decimal places (e.g. 24 or 1.5).
rules.limits.errors.positive: Must be greater than 0 — leave it blank for no limit.
rules.limits.errors.atLeastOne: Must be at least 1 — leave it blank for no limit.
rules.limits.errors.aboveCustomerTotal: Can't be more than the per-customer total.
rules.limits.errors.aboveBudgetTotal: Can't be more than the total budget.
rules.limits.errors.periodRequired: Choose a period for the per-period caps.
